demo_accounts.name: Robin Super
demo_accounts.permissions: approve accounts, set rider fees, view all info, block customers, send notices, view complaints, create coins, hold branches/products, daily reports, hold product

demo_accounts.name: Robin Management
demo_accounts.permissions: view overall business performance, total sales reports, branch performance, rider performance, customer growth, marketing campaigns

demo_accounts.name: Robin Branch
demo_accounts.permissions: view orders with sound, change status, view rider info/GPS, assign rider, set delivery zone/time, complaints, bookings (table layout), messaging/chat

demo_accounts.name: Robin Accounts
demo_accounts.permissions: view payments, manage rider commission, withdrawal approval, financial reports, refund processing, audit log

demo_accounts.name: Robin Marketing
demo_accounts.permissions: manage campaigns (discount coupons, offers, promotions), target audience segmentation, send marketing notifications, monitor performance

demo_accounts.name: Robin Rider
demo_accounts.permissions: login with credentials, view assigned orders, accept delivery, update status, notify customer, message customer, GPS navigation, online/offline switch, commission tracking, withdrawal request, attendance, complaint submission

demo_accounts.name: Robin Customer
demo_accounts.permissions: login, browse food, place order at nearest branch, out of delivery zone message + nearest pickup point, track order, profile info, notifications toggle, order history, repeat/re-order, feedback, complaints, live rider location, rewards/coins

note: All demo accounts use the same login page (auth/login.blade.php) — same dark theme (#0c0c0e), amber glow (#f5a623), red accent (#e8192c), fonts DM Sans + Barlow Condensed.
